title: Baana Kaathadi
desc: Ramesh spends his time flying kites and playing games along with his friends on the streets. However, his life takes a turn for the better when he accidentally meets an aspiring designer, Priya.

title: Mounam Pesiyadhe
desc: Gautam, uninterested in romance, slowly finds his world shifting when Sandhya enters his life, but before he understands his feelings, family decisions complicate matters.

title: Ramana
desc: Ramanaa, a professor, heads a secret group that eliminates corruption from society. They kidnap 15 most corrupt employees from each government department and kill the most unscrupulous one.

title: Boys
desc: A group of five friends live a carefree life until they face the struggles of adulthood. In an attempt to become independent, they start a music band and strive to become famous.

title: Aadukalam
desc: Pettaikaaran has an impeccable track record of successes in rooster fights. However, when one of his aides, Karuppu, does not follow his instructions in a fight, it creates enmity between them.
